_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Oyo ezali mokeli {player_id} na Tic Tac Toe.
Ndinga na yo ezali kufata mitano na moko (na ntango, na vertika, to na diagonal) na lopango.
Na turn na yo, ozali kokota numero ya kala (0-8) oyo ozali kozala kufuta na yo mwana.
Fala, '[4]' ekolakisa mwana na yo na cell ya kati ya lopango.
Mpongi mokeli {player_id}, ozali '{symbol}', wakati mokonzi na yo ezali '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Likambo oyo batindi elandi lolenge ya malamu te.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ezali cellule ya malamu te. Esengeli kozala kati na 0 mpe 8.

game_action.placed: Mokeli {player_id} akeli symbole na ye ({symbol}) na cell {cell}.

outcome.draw: Lisano yango ezali na nsuka te!
